"'''Who Cares (If Freedom's Gone)?'''" was a<ref name="GG9" /> [[Core Drive/Legends|Core Drive]]<ref name="Slugthrowers" /> [[Music/Legends|song]] by the [[Band/Legends|band]] [[Boba Fett and the Assassin Droids]]. The track, published as a single, was available in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in the period of [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="GG9" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' is set in the [[Time/Legends|time period]] between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Those battles are dated to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', which also establishes the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] as the final event before the beginning of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> The song was deemed to contain an anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] message by the [[Imperial Board of Culture]], and it was banned as a result.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Who Cares (If Freedom's Gone)?" was mentioned in the [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' titled ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''. The guide was written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]].<ref name="GG9" />
